title_protection.quote: A person shall not use the word "pawn", "pawnshop" or "pawnbroker" in its business name, on any sign or in any advertisement unless the person is licensed as a pawnbroker pursuant to this article.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making false statements or material misrepresentations in the license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The sheriff shall not issue a license to a person or corporation that has knowingly made any false statements or material misrepresentations in the license application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a previously issued pawnbroker license within one year before application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The sheriff shall not issue a license to a person who, within one year before the application, has violated any provision of a previously issued pawnbroker license or has had a license revoked.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A pawnbroker shall obtain a separate license for each pawnshop owned by that pawnbroker.

max_interest_rate_annual_pct.value: 13% per month for the first two months, 11% per month thereafter
max_interest_rate_annual_pct.quote: A pawnbroker may charge or receive interest at a rate not exceeding thirteen per cent per month for the first two months and at a rate not exceeding eleven per cent per month thereafter.

installment_loans_prohibited.quote: A pawnbroker shall prorate interest on a daily basis and shall not impose an additional charge if the pledgor agrees to pay a loan in monthly installments

pawn_ticket_required.quote: All pawn transactions must be evidenced by a pawn ticket that is issued at the time of the pawn transaction.

value: Name, address and telephone number of the pawnshop and pledgor
Birth date and physical description of the pledgor (height, weight, hair and eye color)
Number and type of identification document presented by the pledgor
Listing of articles left in possession of the pawnbroker
Maturity date of the pawn transaction (in at least 12-point type)
Principal amount of the pawn transaction

pawn_ticket_required_fields.quote: A pawn ticket shall include, at a minimum, all of the following: 1. The name, address and telephone number of the pawnshop and pledgor. 2. The birth date and physical description of the pledgor, including height, weight and hair and eye color. 3. The number and type of the identification document presented by the pledgor. 4. A listing of the articles left in the possession of the pawnbroker. 5. The date of the pawn transaction. 6. The maturity date of the pawn transaction, which shall be set forth in at least twelve point type. 7. The principal amount of the pawn transaction. 8. The following statement in at least ten point type

pledger_identity_verification_required.quote: Before entering into a pawn transaction or good faith outright purchase of tangible personal property a pawnbroker shall require the pledgor or seller to identify himself with an identification document sufficient to verify the information required pursuant to section 44-1625.

records_retention_period_years.quote: shall retain the records for at least two years after the date when the transaction occurred

minimum_pledger_age.quote: A pawnbroker shall not enter into a pawn transaction or good faith outright purchase of tangible personal property with a person who is less than eighteen years of age.

unredeemed_pledge_min_hold_days_before_s.quote: A pawnbroker shall not sell any items pledged to him as security for a pawn transaction until at least the day after the maturity date.

license_nontransferable.quote: A pawnbroker license may not be sold or transferred without the approval of the sheriff or the sheriff's designee.

one_license_per_location.quote: A pawnbroker shall obtain a separate license for each pawnshop owned by that pawnbroker.

stolen_property_reporting_required.quote: A pawnbroker shall make a true, complete and accurate report each day of each article the pawnbroker receives through a reportable transaction.
